fact: 1912年10月8日，黑山首先对奥斯曼帝国宣战，巴尔干同盟其余成员在10天后跟进，第一次巴尔干战争爆发；同盟由塞尔维亚、保加利亚、希腊、黑山组成，在俄国支持下于1912年春形成，联军可投入约75万人。

sources.title: Britannica — Balkan Wars
sources.quote: Montenegro opened hostilities by declaring war on Turkey on October 8, 1912, and the other members of the league followed suit 10 days later.

fact: 1912年10月至11月，保加利亚军队在色雷斯击溃奥斯曼主力，推进至君士坦丁堡郊外并围攻埃迪尔内（阿德里安堡）；塞尔维亚军在库马诺沃大胜后占领比托拉并与黑山军会师进入斯科普里；希腊军占领萨洛尼卡并向约阿尼纳推进。

sources.title: Britannica — Balkan Wars
sources.quote: In Thrace the Bulgarians defeated the main Ottoman forces, advancing to the outskirts of Constantinople and laying siege to Adrianople (Edirne). In Macedonia the Serbian army achieved a great victory at Kumanovo that enabled it to capture Bitola and to join forces with the Montenegrins and enter Skopje. The Greeks, meanwhile, occupied Salonika (Thessaloníki) and advanced on Ioánnina.

fact: 奥斯曼军队的崩溃使各方同意于1912年12月3日停战，随后在伦敦开始和平会议；由于1913年1月青年土耳其党人在君士坦丁堡发动政变，战事重启，最终在1913年5月30日的伦敦和约中，奥斯曼帝国失去在欧洲的几乎所有剩余领土，包括马其顿与阿尔巴尼亚。

sources.title: Britannica — Balkan Wars
sources.quote: The Turkish collapse was so complete that all parties were willing to conclude an armistice on December 3, 1912. A peace conference was begun in London, but, after a coup d’état by the Young Turks in Constantinople in January 1913, war with the Ottomans was resumed.

fact: 奥斯曼方面于1912年10月1日开始局部动员，10月16日对巴尔干诸国宣战，保加利亚与塞尔维亚于17日宣战、希腊两日后宣战；Britannica 则以黑山10月8日宣战、其余成员10天后跟进为时间轴，两套日期并存。

sources.title: Turkey in the First World War — Balkan Wars
sources.quote: Eventually, the Turks also decided to commence mobilization on a limited scale starting on 1 October 1912 … The Ottoman Empire declared war on the Balkan states on 16 October, prompting Bulgaria and Serbia to declare war on 17 October, with Greece following suit two days later.

fact: 第一次巴尔干战争期间，奥斯曼帝国首次将非穆斯林男性臣民与穆斯林一同征召入伍，改变了此前非穆斯林缴纳免役税而不服兵役的惯例；这一变化在1912年秋的动员中开始执行。

sources.title: Turkey in the First World War — Balkan Wars
sources.quote: A significant development was the enlistment of non-Muslim male subjects alongside Muslims, a departure from the historical norm.

fact: 1912年战前，奥斯曼公共债务的一半以上由法国资本持有；法国因此主导列强劝阻巴尔干开战的努力，因为战争将使其债权大幅贬值。

sources.title: Turkey in the First World War — Balkan Wars

fact: 1912年，阿尔廷·阿尔斯兰扬获准在尼尚塔什的塔什奥贾厄设立奥斯曼帝国第一家面包工厂，从维也纳进口机器，日产能为每只720克的面包3万只；此后乌恩卡帕讷又开设尼梅特面包厂，缓解了首都的面包短缺。

sources.title: Motley Turkey — The Ottoman Empire's Bread Supply and Its First Bread Factory
sources.quote: With state approval, he founded the “Arslanyan Ekmek ve Mamulât-ı Dakikiye Şirket-i Osmaniyesi” in 1912. After importing machinery from Vienna, the first bread factory of the Ottoman Empire was established in Nişantaşı … The Nişantaşı Bread Factory could produce 30,000 loaves of 720 grams each per day.
